_deal: The board's test node. Which Infestation node deals it (the two hold one pool) is Eliza's, her letter.
author: jessica
source: Eliza's letter 2026-10-26 (office/correspondence/2026-10-26-eliza-jessica-infestations-for-the-board.md), on his week goal: "This week I'd like to have at least one of each of the new missions set and the old in the legacy nodes."
_note: THE INFESTATION FAMILY, 1 OF 2: A SITE THAT WENT QUIET. His MB16 (surface predators, 13 originals): go where animals have
taken over, kill them, leave. Voice on the clear, from the client (mission-types.md, type 3).
REWRITTEN 2026-10-26 after his play: every site in the pool has residents, and on his idea they now die when the first
call plays (place.residents "dead"). So the people are already dead when he arrives, and the predators are among them.
The client is a neighbour who lost contact, not a resident going home. Restrained on purpose: nobody describes the bodies.
One species, as a Hunt. Pay: med, capped.

place._theme: A non-hostile built site, where somebody lives; the lint measures what a request can place.
place._residents: His 2026-10-26: every site in this pool carries a resident tag, so they die when the first radio call plays (place.residents).
place._pool: 24 on 2026-10-26, under Overtime's narrowest (44). Widening to every built non-dungeon site gives 40, but that adds hostile sites whose own occupants fight too, and the words are about people who live there. Kept narrow; his call.

prose.name: Infestation: Predators at the <Place> on <Planet>
prose.briefing: The <Place> went quiet three days ago. Predators have been seen around it since.
prose.card: Local Contract. Clear the predators from the <Place> on <Planet>. Payment on contract completion.

beats.objective: Clear the predators out of the <Place>
beats.journal: The people at the <Place> were already dead when I got there, and the predators were still in among them. They're gone now, so somebody can go in and see to the dead.
say: It's done. I'll get some people together and go up. Thank you for going in first, none of us wanted to.

broadcast: From where you are, you can see more than I can. They stopped answering three days ago, and we heard the animals at night after that. Clear out whatever's still in there, because somebody has to go in and see to them.
_speech: A neighbour from further along, quiet, has guessed what you'll find and doesn't say it. Killian, his ear decides. No names, places, factions or currency.
